question: Where can I get the available grid connection capacity per substation or node in the United States, for generation and for demand, with the latest value and its history?

answer.summary: No national US dataset of available connection capacity exists. Capacity is published utility by utility, mostly as ArcGIS services. Three were queried live: PG&E (GRIP: generation and load capacity in kW per line section, 2.09M sections), SCE (ICA per circuit segment, MAX_REMAIN_CAP per substation, available load capacity per circuit/substation for five plan years) and National Grid New York (PV hosting capacity per feeder and substation bank, no demand). CAISO's transmission heatmap shows substation headroom but offers no data download. No history was found in any service tested.
main_caveats: Distribution values are indicative hosting capacity (ICA), not a guarantee of connection; PG&E and others state that all interconnections are subject to engineering review.
Level differs: PG&E gives line sections, SCE circuit segments plus substations, National Grid feeders and substation banks; only some of them give an identifiable substation value.
Only 3 of about 58 utilities/agencies listed in the DOE atlas (May 2024) were queried; transmission headroom exists only as CAISO's viewer, without data.
No service declares units: kW for PG&E and MW for National Grid are inferred from field names; SCE units are unknown (its user guide returned HTTP 403).
Queue and project layers (e.g. PG&E queued DG, GNA needs) are not available capacity and were excluded.
Services expose only the current snapshot plus per-record analysis dates; no archived series was found.
answer.confidence_reason: Live queries worked for three utilities, but coverage is utility-specific, SCE units and SDG&E were not verified, and history was not found.

attributes.note: PG&E EDSubstations (777) and line sections; SCE substations (735) and node_id; National Grid substation bank (t_node/t_ptid), 1,913 feeders.
attributes.gap_note: Not every utility names substations; national coverage absent (3 utilities tested).

attributes.note: PG&E GenCapacity_kW; SCE ica_overall_pv and MAX_REMAIN_CAP; NG feeder_min_hc/max_hc (PV); CAISO heatmap in MW (viewer).
attributes.gap_note: Only utilities with a public map; calculation conditions differ and CAISO transmission values are not downloadable.

attributes.note: PG&E LoadCapacity_kW per line section; SCE ica_overall_load and available load capacity (alc_year1-5) per circuit/substation.
attributes.gap_note: National Grid NY layers tested give PV only; no transmission demand headroom found.

attributes.note: PG&E layers edited 2026-10-29/2026-11-06, ICA dates up to Aug 2026; SCE load capacity 2026-11-19; NG hosting refresh 2026-03-31.
attributes.gap_note: SCE ICA segments last edited 2025-09-17 (ICA table dated 2025-02-14); reference dates differ per record.

attributes.note: Tested services expose only the current snapshot; per-record analysis dates show different vintages but not earlier values.
attributes.gap_note: No archive or earlier values were found in the three services; Wayback copies or ArcGIS item versions were not checked.

attributes.note: CAISO states about 3 updates per year; NG shows hca_refresh 2026-03-31 and DG refresh 2026-10-02; PG&E ICA dates span monthly.
attributes.gap_note: PG&E, SCE and National Grid state no schedule on the services; frequency is inferred from dates.

sources.name: PG&E Grid Resource Integration Portal (GRIP) - ICA line sections
sources.format: ArcGIS REST FeatureServer (JSON, GeoJSON, CSV via query)
sources.summary: Open ArcGIS service with generation and load capacity in kW per line section, plus substations and feeders.
sources.coverage_note: PG&E territory only; 2.09M line sections, 777 substations.

problems: No metadata declares units; kW taken from field names.

example.example_result: KING CITY 1106, section 3952502: load 50 kW, generation 0 kW, limited by Voltage, ICA Jun 2026.

sources.name: SCE Distributed Resources Plan External Portal (DRPEP) - ICA and available load capacity
sources.format: ArcGIS FeatureServer (JSON, CSV, GeoJSON, Shapefile via Hub)
sources.summary: ArcGIS Hub with ICA for load and PV per circuit segment, a substation remaining-capacity layer and available load capacity by plan year.

problems: SCE DERiM user guide URL returned HTTP 403, so units and method were not verified.
Layer dates for ICA are 2025; verify freshness.

example.example_result: Windsor Hills (SUBST_ID 505): MAX_REMAIN_CAP 10.68, TOTAL_GEN 2.818, QUEUED_GEN 0.276; Tamarisk/Agave section 207621115: ica_overall_load 2.14, ica_overall_pv 4.

sources.name: National Grid New York System Data Portal - Hosting Capacity Data
sources.summary: ArcGIS REST service of PV hosting capacity per feeder and substation bank with NYISO node ids.
sources.coverage_note: National Grid NY, 1,913 feeders; hosting analysis 2026-03-31.

problems: No unit or method metadata on the service.

sources.name: CAISO Points of Interconnection Heatmap
sources.summary: Only transmission-level source found; viewer with substation headroom, no data download.
sources.coverage_note: ISO-controlled substations; refreshed about 3 times a year.

problems: The heatmap page URL tried returned 404; only the FAQ was read.
Data are not downloadable per the FAQ.

sources.summary: DOE index of 58 utility and agency hosting-capacity maps; a pointer, not a dataset.

members_summary.scope_note: Universe: 58 utilities and agencies per the DOE Atlas (May 2024). Five were listed here; three returned live capacity data, one was blocked and one was not tested.

local_terms.meaning: Integration Capacity Analysis: California utilities' hosting-capacity method.
Indicative distribution capacity available for new generation or load.
Distribution circuit and its segments, the unit of PG&E and SCE ICA.
